spans.s:
मृण् मृण् (connected with rts. मृ,
मॄ), cl. 6. P. मृणति, ममर्ण,
मृणितुम्, to kill, slay; [cf. Gr. μάρναμαι.]

मृणाल मृणाल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be
also ई, f.), the edible fibrous root of some kinds of
lotus, a lotus fibre or small fibre attached to the stalk
of a water-lily; (ई), f. a lotus fibre; (अम्), n. the
root of the fragrant grass Andropogon Muricatus.
—मृणाल-भङ्ग, अस्, m. the fracture of a lotus
fibre.
—मृणाल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing lotus
fibres or roots.
—मृणाल-सूत्र, अम्, n. the fibre
of a lotus stalk.

मृणालक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of comps.) =
मृणाल; (इका), f. the edible root of a lotus; a
proper N.

मृणालिन्, ई, m. a lotus; (इनी), f. a lotus plant;
a group of lotuses; a place where lotuses grow.

मृण्मय मृण्-मय, incorrectly for मृन्-
मय under 2. मृद्, col. 3.
